channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Zelenskyy urges US to release Patriot missiles as Russia kills 3 in Ukraine
item.description: A Russian drone attack kills at least two people near Kyiv as Russian shelling kills one in Zaporizhzhia.

item.title: Iran unveils dual-missile launcher, new ‘missile city’: What to know
item.description: Military officials tour underground facility in show of military capabilities despite US attacks.

item.title: What next for Iraq’s push against militias following Jurf al-Sakhar deal?
item.description: Baghdad's deal with Kataib Hezbollah may not end the Iran-backed militia's influence over the town.

item.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts drone, missile as Houthis report attack on Sanaa
item.description: Houthi media say several people were injured in an attack on an oil company as Saudi air defences down a drone.

item.title: US Congress helped end the Vietnam War. Can it stop the Iran war?
item.description: Congress forbade funding for the Vietnam War, contributing to the fall of the South Vietnamese government in Saigon.

item.title: What’s behind Iran’s escalation of attacks in the Gulf?
item.description: Tehran has ramped up attacks as the US naval blockade and sanctions campaign hurt the country economically.

item.title: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
item.description: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.

item.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
item.description: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

item.title: US declassifies more UFO footage filmed in the Middle East
item.description: The Pentagon has released an eighth tranche of UFO records, which includes three video clips recorded in 2020, 2023 and 2026.
